system.name: SpeechFlow
system.one_liner: A generative speech model pre-trained with flow matching and masked audio on 60k hours of untranscribed speech, then fine-tuned with task-specific conditions.

content.variant_note: pre-training and fine-tuning drawn as two columns that reuse the same network box, split by a black rule and tied by a dashed arrow, with a flow-path sketch at the far left
content.argues: Pre-train a flow-matching network on masked-audio infilling, then fine-tune the same network with a task-specific condition in place of the mask.
content.subject: Spectrograms entering a flow-matching network with random weights, then the same network with pre-trained weights taking a task condition, each with its loss.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a pretrain-then-finetune recipe by drawing the same network box once per stage with only its weights label (Random θ, Pre-trained θ) and the bottom input changed, split by a vertical rule and tied by one dashed arrow; the swapped input and the named loss above each box show the difference without extra text.

we pre-trained a generative model, named SpeechFlow, on 60k hours of untranscribed speech with Flow Matching and masked conditions

summary: SpeechFlow is a generative speech model pre-trained with flow matching and masked audio conditions on 60k hours of untranscribed speech, then fine-tuned with task-specific conditions such as a noisy recording, overlapped speech or a phone sequence. Figure 1 sets the two stages side by side, split by a black vertical rule. At the far left a green arrow carries a noise spectrogram x_0 to a speech spectrogram x_1 with a time node t. Beside it a light blue Random θ box takes ψ_t(x_0) and a masked spectrogram x_mask and outputs the vector field for the flow-matching loss (Eq.4). A dashed arrow leads to a Pre-trained θ box that takes a peach task-specific condition y instead (Eq.5).
summary_zh: SpeechFlow 先用流匹配和掩码音频在六万小时无标注语音上预训练，再用噪声录音、重叠语音或音素序列等任务条件微调。图中黑色竖线分开两个阶段：左边随机初始化的网络输入掩码频谱，右边预训练网络输入任务条件，各附流匹配损失公式。
notes: No paragraph mentions the figure; the roles of ψ_t(x_0), the green path and the dashed arrow rest on the figure, the caption and standard flow-matching notation. The two columns carry no titles in the figure, so panel labels are null. The canvas is wider than the drawing: about a quarter of it at the right is empty.
